title: A sound returns underwater
hook: An echo carries a clue about a distant object.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: One arrow traces an outgoing sound and the other its return after encountering the object. Dolphins use echoes to locate objects underwater. This diagram omits the sound-production anatomy and does not model travel time.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: In this underwater model, what reaches the dolphin after its sound encounters an object?
